toast_invalid_date_format_full: Ifomethi yelanga engasebenziko. Khetha ilanga elizeleko.
auth_sign_in_subtitle: Finyelela indawo yakho yokusebenza esibhedlela ngokuphepha.
auth_welcome_back_body: Ngena ngemvumo ukulawula iingulani, i-inventory, ukubekwa, kanye nokugeleza komsebenzi wezokwelapha wesiqhema sakho.
auth_welcome_signup_body: Yenza i-akhawundi yokuphatha iingulani, i-inventory, ama-aphoyintimenti, kanye nokugeleza komsebenzi wezokwelapha wesiqhema sakho.
auth_forgot_subtitle: Faka i-imeyili ku-akhawunti yakho. Sizokuthumela isixhumanisi sokusetha kabutjha nangabe sifana nomsebenzisi otlolisiweko.
auth_check_email_body: Nangabe i-{email} ibhalisiwe, isixhumanisi sokusetha kabutjha sisendleleni. Isixhumanisi siphela ngemva kwemizuzu eli-15.
auth_otp_subtitle: Sithumele ikhodi enamadijithi asithandathu ku-{email}. Iphela ngemva kwemizuzu eli-10.
auth_2fa_subtitle: Faka ikhodi enamadijithi asithandathu ukusuka kuhlelo lokusebenza lwakho lokuqinisekisa.
auth_2fa_setup_subtitle: Qinisekisa iphasiwedi yakho ukwenza ikhodi ye-QR yokuqinisekisa.
auth_2fa_setup_scan_subtitle: Skena nge-app yakho yokuqinisekisa, bese ufaka ikhodi enamadijithi ayi-6.
auth_2fa_backup_codes_subtitle: Gcina amakhodi la endaweni ephephileko. Ikhodi ngayinye ingasetjenziswa kanye.
auth_2fa_account_disable_hint: Faka iphasiwedi yakho ukuvala ukuqinisekiswa okubili.
auth_2fa_account_change_hint: Faka isiqinisekiso sakho. Ama-app akhona azokulisa ukusebenza bekube kulapho uskena i-QR etja.
auth_2fa_setup_change_subtitle: Qinisekisa iphasiwedi yakho ukufaka esikhundleni sekhodi yakho ye-QR.
auth_2fa_account_backup_regen_hint: Faka iphasiwedi yakho. Amakhodi wesipele wangaphambilini azokulisa ukusebenza.
auth_2fa_account_backup_regen_success: Amakhodi amatjha wokusekela alungile. Zigcine endaweni ephephileko.
session_extend_description: Qinisekisa iphasiwedi yakho ukufaka amanye ama-awa amabili esigabeni lesi.
session_extend_password_hint: Faka iphasiwedi ye-akhawunti ongene ngayo. Unganweba kanye ngeseshini.
auth_2fa_account_multi_device_hint: Ngesikhathi sokuhlela ungaskena i-QR efanako ngedivayisi engaphezu kweyodwa.
auth_2fa_required_for_action: Ukuqinisekiswa okunezinto ezimbili kuyatlhogeka malungana nesenzo lesi. Yenza bona iragele phambili.
enter_email_reset_description: Faka i-imeyili yakho sizokuthumela isixhumanisi sokusetha kabutjha iphasiwedi yakho.
invalid_reset_link: Isixhumanisi sokusetha kabutjha esingasebenziko nofana esiphelelwe sikhathi. Sibawa ubawe etja ngezansi.
password_min_length: Iphasiwedi kufanele ibe neenhlamvu ezi-8 okungenani.
reset_email_sent: Nangabe i-akhawundi ikhona ye-imeyili le, isixhumanisi sokusetha kabutjha iphasiwedi sithunyelwe.
password_reset_success: Ukusetha kabutjha iphasiwedi kuphumelele. Nje-ke ungakghona ukungena.
op_billing_discount_locked_after_print: Umthethosivivinywa lo bewugadangisiwe; isaphulelo sezinga lokuvakatjha angeze satjhugululwa.
op_billing_discount_locked_tooltip: Isaphulelo sivalelwe ngemva kokuthi ibhili igadangisiwe.
op_billing_bill_close_blocked_nursing: Ubuhlengikazi obupheleleko abukapheli; umthethomlingwa awukwazi ukuvalwa.
op_billing_nothing_to_close: Akukho misebenzi eqediweko elindele ukukhokhiswa kokuvakatjha.
op_billing_no_services_found: Akukho misebenzi eqediweko elindele ukubhadelwa kokuvakatjha.
op_billing_readiness_nursing_hint: Qeda ubuhlengikazi obupheleleko kiyo yoke imigqa yesevisi ngaphambi kokuvala.
ip_billing_discount_locked_after_print: Umthethosivivinywa lo bewugadangisiwe; isaphulelo sezinga lokuvakatjha angeze satjhugululwa.
ip_billing_bill_close_blocked_nursing: Ubuhlengikazi obupheleleko abukapheli; umthethomlingwa awukwazi ukuvalwa.
ip_billing_no_services_found: Akukho misebenzi ebhadelwako etholakeleko malungana nokuvakatjha lokhu.
no_hospital_assigned: Asikho isibhedlela esabelwe ku-akhawundi yakho. Thintana nomlawuli wakho.
no_hospitals_yet: Akukho zibhedlela okwanje. Yenza eyodwa ukuze uqalise.
owner_no_hospitals_yet: Akukho zibhedlela okwanje. Thintana nomlawuli wakho ukobana uqalise.
hospital_coding_system_help: Ibophelela isibhedlela lesi esigabeni esisodwa sekhodi yokuhlola ye-WHO. Angeze yatjhuguluka ngemva kobana kube nokuhlolwa okukhowudiweko.
hospital_coding_system_locked: Irherho lokukhowuda livaliwe ngombana isibhedlela sele sineenhlolo ezikhowudiweko.
hospital_coding_release_line: I-{system} ikhuphe i-{releaseId} (amakhodi we-{count}, i-{importedAt} engeniswako)
icd_who_attribution: Okuqukethwe kwe-ICD-10 ne-ICD-11 kunelungelo lokutlola le-World Health Organization (WHO). I-ICD-11 inelayisense ngaphasi kwe-CC BY-ND 3.0 IGO. Ukusetjenziswa kutlhoga ukunikela; ukutjhuguluka kutlhoga imvumo ye-WHO.
docs_coding_standards_body: Isibhedlela ngasinye sibophelela ihlelo lokukhowuda lokuhlolisisa i-WHO (i-ICD-10 nofana i-ICD-11 MMS) ngesikhathi sokwenza. Ukusesha kokuhlolwa kwe-EMR kusebenzisa ikhathalogu leyo kwaphela. Amakhathalogu apheleleko angeniswa nge-WHO ICD-API etafuleni elikhulu elabelwana ngalo.
name: Ibizo
admin_no_hospitals_yet: Akukho zibhedlela okwanje. Yenza eyodwa bese ubopha umnikazi.
admin_team_subtitle: Mema abasizi bese ubeka bona ngimaphi amakhasi womlawuli abangawasebenzisa.
admin_team_need_view: Okungenani ikhasi elilodwa kufanele libe nemvumo yokubuka.
admin_team_invite_hint: Bazokwamukela i-imeyili yokubuyisela iphasiwedi ukusetha iphasiwedi yabo.
admin_team_matrix_hint: Ukubona kuyatlhogeka ngaphambi kokudala, ukuhlela, nofana ukususa ekhasini.
admin_team_reset_failed: Akukghoni ukuthumela i-imeyili yokusetha kabutjha iphasiwedi.
admin_monitoring_subtitle: Ukusetjenziswa, umsebenzi wakamuva, kanye nepilo yedathabheyisi.
admin_staff_subtitle: Boke abasebenzisi abanendima yabasebenzi kizo zoke iimbhedlela.
admin_ops_subtitle: Ukusetjenziswa bukhoma, umsebenzi wakamuva, kanye nepilo yedathabheyisi.
admin_ops_usage_subtitle: Iinkhathi kanye nokwakhiwa kwakamuva okuvela kudathabheyisi ebukhoma.
admin_ops_db_quota_note: Isabelo sepulani asivezwa nge-SQL. Qala ikhonsoli ye-Neon malungana nesitoreji esikhona.
admin_ops_db_note_size_from_pg: Ubukhulu bedathabheyisi buvela ku-PostgreSQL pg_database_size (ubukhulu obuzwakalako egatjeni le-Neon).
admin_ops_db_note_quota_via_neon: Isabelo sesitoreji sepulani ye-neon asitholakali nge-SQL. Okusetjenzisiweko nofana okutholakalako kutlhoga ikhonsoli ye-Neon nofana i-API ye-Neon.
admin_ops_db_note_live_counts: Iinbalo zemigqa yethebula ziyi-COUNT(*) ebukhoma emathebuleni aqakathekileko, ingasi ukulinganisa kwe-pg_stat.
admin_ops_db_note_connection_failed: Iphenyo lokuxhumana lihlulekile. Hlola i-DATABASE_URL kanye nobujamo begatja le-Neon.
no_owners_yet: Akunabanikazi okwanje. Yenza eyodwa ukuze bavumele bona bafikelele ezibhedlela.
no_user_groups_yet: Akunamaqembu wabasebenzisi okwanje. Yenza eyodwa ozoyinikela abasebenzi.
no_user_groups_create: Awekho amaqembu wabasebenzisi. Yenza enye ngehla.
no_branches_yet: Akukabi namagatja okwanje. Faka igatja lesi sibhedlela.
no_user_groups: Awekho amaqembu wabasebenzisi atholakalako esibhedlela lesi.
user_groups_optional_hint: Khetha isiqhema sinye nofana ngaphezulu sabasebenzisi (ngokuzikhethela).
store_central_help: Okungenani eyodwa ngegatja ngalinye. I-GRN ithumela ipahla esitolo lesi. Nangabe sele unesitolo esiphakathi egatjeni, sicime lapho ngaphambi kobana usivumele lapha.
item_master_barcode_scan_hint: Iimskena ze-USB zivamise ukuthayipha endaweni egxilwe kiyo. Ukuskena kwekhamera kungafakwa ngokukhamba kwesikhathi.
item_master_batch_required_help: Lokha nakuvunyelwe, irisidi yepahla kufanele ifake inomboro yeqoqo, ilanga lokuphelelwa sikhathi, kanye nentengo yokuthenga yento le (okujayelekileko ekhemisi).
item_master_unit_conversions_default_toa: Khetha iyunithi yento kokuthoma, bese usebenzisa i-Default ukumadanisa amatjhuguluko afaka hlangana.
Akukho ukutjhugululwa kweyunithi kusebenzisa iyunithi le nto ekuthengeni nofana ekukhutjhweni.
item_master_unit_conversions_default_req: Khetha okuzenzakalelayo phakathi kokuguqulwa kweyunithi okufakiwe.
item_master_category_hint: Ukuphakelwa okujayelekileko kwaphela, ukuphakelwa kwekhemisi, nofana ukuphakelwa kwezokwelapha (okuvela esigabeni esikhulu).
item_master_pharmacy_generic_required: Khetha ikhemisi elijwayelekileko lezinto eziphakelwa yikhemisi.
no_pharmacy_generics_create: Awekho amakhemisi ajwayelekileko. Yenza enye ngehla.
unit_master_empty: Akukabi namayunithi okwanje. Yenza enye ngehla.
no_item_unit_profiles: Akukho ukuguqulwa okwamanje. Yenza enye ngehla.
confirm_delete_refer: Uqinisekile bona ufuna ukususa ireferensi le?
nursing_case_sheet_save_success: Ikhasi lekheyisi ligcinwe eentweni ezinamathiselweko zesiguli.
nursing_case_sheet_save_failed: Kwehlulekile ukulondoloza ikhasi lekheyisi kuma-attachment wesiguli.
clinical_document_save_failed: Kwehlulekile ukulondoloza ifomu eentweni ezinamathiselweko zesiguli.
nursing_case_sheet_choose_visit: Khetha ukuvakatjhela ngokusebenzisa ibhathini elithi 'Khetha ukuvakatjhela' elingenhla ukubona iphepha lecala.
observation_emr_choose_visit: Khetha ukuvakatjhela usebenzisa ibhathini elithi 'Khetha ukuvakatjha' elingenhla ukubuka idatha yokutjheja.
clinical_visit_signed_banner: Ukuvakatjha lokhu kulondolozwe njengokutlikitlwa. Ukutjheja nokuhlela i-CPOE kukhubazekile bekube kulapho ukhetha enye ivakatjho.
clinical_visit_unsign_confirm: Ingabe uyaqiniseka bona hlehlisa ukulondoloza njengombana kusayinwe?
observation_save_as_signed_confirm: Londoloza ukuvakatjha lokhu njengombana kusayinwe? Lokhu angeze kwabuyiselwa emuva. Ukutjheja nokuhlela i-CPOE kuzokukhubazeka malungana nokuvakatjha lokhu; iindawo zokusebenza zobuhlengikazi ziyatholakala.
observation_emr_casesheet_stub: Ihlelo lokuTjheja alitholakali kilokhu kwakhiwa. Sebenzisa ihlelo lokutlhogomela le-EMR lobuhlengikazi lokha nasele lilungile.
observation_emr_plan_of_care_empty: Alikho ihlelo lokutlhogomela ukungena kwalokhu kuvakatjha.
observation_emr_progress_note_stub: Amanothi wokuragela phambili awatholakali kilokhu kwakha. Sebenzisa amanothi wentuthuko ye-EMR yobuhlengikazi lokha nasele ilungile.
observation_emr_progress_note_empty: Awekho amanothi wentuthuko malungana nokuvakatjha lokhu.
consultation_cpoe_prescription_note_plac: Tlola imiyalo, imithi, umthamo, kanye nesiyeleliso sesigulani...
consultation_cpoe_prescription_empty: Akukabi namanothi wemithi yokuvakatjha lokhu okwanje.
observation_emr_order_line_locked_op_bil: Umugqa lo usemthethweni we-OP ovaliweko begodu angeze wahlelwa nofana ungasebenzi.
observation_emr_order_line_inactivate_hi: Umugqa we-oda lo uzakutshwaywa bona ungasebenzi begodu ungafakwa ekubhadelweni kwe-OP.
observation_emr_form_entry_inactivate_hi: Thayipha godu ihlathululo yokufaka engezansi ukuvala lokhu okufakiweko.
delete_owner_confirm_suffix: ? Lokhu kuzokususa i-akhawunti yabo begodu angeze basakghona ukungena.
prefix_configuration_format_help: Iingcezu zihlanganiswa ukwenzela bona kwakhiwe ikhodi ngayinye. Faka umtlolo ongatjhugulukiko, amasimu wedatha, nenombolo esebenzako.
prefix_configuration_format_empty: Faka okungenani isiqetjhana sinye kufomethi yekhodi.
prefix_configuration_format_load_failed: Ifomethi elondoloziweko ayikwazanga ukulayishwa; ukuthoma ngokuhleleka okuzenzakalelayo.
prefix_configuration_page_subtitle: Setha bona amakhodi wesigulani, iinomboro zokuvakatjhela, kanye neenomboro ze-oda lesevisi zakhiwe njani. Injongo ngayinye isebenzisa ikhi yesistimu engatjhugulukiko; utjhugulula ihlathululo nefomethi kwaphela.
prefix_configuration_purpose_patient_hel: Isetjenziswa lokha nakutloliswa iingulani ezitjha. Umhlobo wokuvakatjhela awutholakali kile khodi.
prefix_configuration_purpose_visit_help: Isetjenziselwa ukuvakatjhela kwesigulani ngasinye; ifaka hlangana umhlobo wegatja nokuvakatjhela lokha amasimu lawo asefomethini.
prefix_configuration_purpose_order_help: Isetjenziswa lokha nakwenziwa ama-oda wesevisi. Ifomethi ekhethiweko ihambelana no-YY/vakatjhela/NNN. Vulela “Ukulandelana okuhlukileko ngokuvakatjha” ukwenzela bona iinomboro ze-oda zibalwe 001, 002... ngokuvakatjha kwesiguli (kunconywa). Nangabe ivaliwe, ukulandelana kwabelwana ngakho kiwo woke ama-oda asebenzisa amanye amasethingi afanako.
prefix_configuration_purpose_pr_help: Isetjenziswa lokha nakwenziwa iimbawo zokuthenga (PR). Hlela lokhu ngaphambi kobana abasebenzi benze ama-PR.
prefix_configuration_purpose_po_help: Isetjenziswa lokha nakwenziwa ama-oda wokuthenga (PO). Hlela lokhu ngaphambi kobana abasebenzi benze ama-PO.
prefix_configuration_purpose_di_help: Isetjenziswa lokha nakwenziwa ama-indent womnyango. Lungisa lokhu ngaphambi kobana abasebenzi benze ama-indent.
prefix_configuration_purpose_di_issue_he: Isetjenziswa lokha nakwenziwa iindaba zomnyango ukusuka phakathi ukuya ezitolo ezibawako.
prefix_configuration_purpose_dc_help: Isetjenziswa lokha nakuthunyelwa imitlolo yokusetjenziswa komnyango ukuze ivunywe.
prefix_configuration_purpose_med_order_b: Isetjenziswa lokha nakulondoloza ama-oda wemithi yangaphakathi. Yonke imigqa ekulondolozeni okukodwa yabelana ngenombolo yeqoqo. Ukuzenzakalelayo kusebenzisa umnyaka wezezimali, isibhedlela, nokulandelana kokugijima.
prefix_configuration_counter_scope_help: Khetha bona ngibuphi ubukhulu obuhlukanisa inombolo esebenzako. Ifomethi yokutjengisa engehla ihlukile; lokhu kuthinta kwaphela bona ungakanani ukulandelana okuzijameleko okutholako.
inv_grn_api_hint: Yenza ama-GRN nge-POST nge-poId, i-storeId (phakathi), ilanga elitholiweko, kanye nemigqa. Umugqa ngamunye: i-poLineId, inani elithengiweko (ngaphandle kwamahhala), inomboro yeqoqo, ilanga lokuphela, intengo yokuthengwa (kuyatlhogeka lokha into inokulandelela iqoqo). Amabhetjhi ajwayelekileko (item_batch); isitoko sisesitolo ngasinye nesiquntu (inv_stock).
inv_approval_config_intro: Hlela amazinga wokuvuma nabantu abanikelwe isitolo nomhlobo wedokhumenti oyikhethileko ngehla.
inv_stock_search_modal_hint: Imiphumela yokusesha ifaka hlangana ukutholakala esitolo esikhethiweko (kusukela) kwaphela (iyunithi yokukhipha lokha nayikhona).
inv_receipt_from_store_view_issue_hint: Ukubuka kuvula irisidi ekhasini layo; Ukubuyela emuva lapha (ingasi endabeni yomNyango).
inv_stock_lot_hint: Imigqa yi-`inv_stock` ehlanganiswe ne-`item_batch`, ihlelwe ngokuphela kwesikhathi (FEFO).
inv_user_groups_search_placeholder: Hlunga amaqembu wabasebenzisi ngebizo nofana nge-id...
inv_pr_approve_qty_hint: Faka inani elivunyelweko ngomugqa ngamunye nangabe kufanele lihluke kunalelo eliceliweko. Inani le-PR elindileko lihlanganisa imigqa efanako evela esitolo esibawako (esilindileko, esithunyelwe emuva, nofana esivunyelweko), kufaka hlangana isibawo lesi.
cpoe_order_pending_empty: Azikho izinto okwanje. Chofoza + ukufaka into, bese ulondoloza i-oda.
inv_po_new_lines_need_pr_hint: Khetha isibawo sokuthenga esivunyelweko ngehla. Ithebula lizokulayisha lapha ngomugqa ngamunye: into, iyunithi (Ukuguqulwa kwe-Item Unit Master), inani eliseleko, inani le-oda, kanye nentengo yeyunithi.
inv_po_manual_unit_prereq: Khetha into kokuthoma, bese ukhetha iyunithi (ukuguqulwa) kuhlu lwe-Item Unit Master yento.
inv_po_manual_unit_none_configured: Into le ayinawo amatjhuguluko weyunithi asebenzako. Zilungiselele ngaphasi kokuhlela kwe-Inventory → I-Item master.
inv_po_new_po_pr_cps_only: Khetha isitolo sokuthenga esiphakathi ebha ephezulu. Iimbawo ezivunyelweko ze-oda elitjha lokuthenga zifakwa kwaphela lokha isitolo nasikhethiweko: zithunyelwa ekuthengeni okuphakathi, ingasi kwezinye iintolo ezifana nekhemisi elingasilo i-CPS ehleliweko.
inv_po_cps_not_configured_pr: Hlela isitolo sokuthenga esiphakathi ngaphasi kokuhlelwa kwe-Inventory → Hlela i-inventory yesibhedlela ngaphambi kokwenza ama-oda wokuthenga avela eemfunweni.
inv_po_close_line_confirm: Vala umugqa we-PO bese uphawula inani eliseleko njengelivaliwe?
inv_pr_close_line_confirm: Vala umugqa we-PR osele i-quty (setha ukuvula-kwe-PO ku-0)?
inv_grn_receiving_store_none_central: Asikho isitolo esiphakathi esilungiselelwe igatja le-oda lokuthenga. Irisidi yempahla kufanele ithunyelwe esitolo esiphakathi segatja. Ekuhlelweni kwe-Inventory, maka isitolo sinye ngegatja njengesiphakathi (isitolo esiphakathi), bese uzama godu.
inv_grn_select_po_for_store_hint: Khetha i-oda lokuthenga ukubona isitolo esamukelako.
inv_grn_batch_fields_hint: Inomboro yeqoqo, ukuphelelwa sikhathi, kanye nentengo yokuthenga kuyatlhogeka eentweni ezilandelelweko.
inv_transfer_pick_batch_hint: Khetha okunengi esitolo somthombo, nofana ulayishe okunengi ngemva kokukhetha iintolo.
inv_hub_card_po: Yenza begodu uvume ama-oda wokuthenga, thumela kumthengisi.
inv_hub_card_grn: Tlola irisidi yepahla malungana nama-oda wokuthenga.
inv_store_central_purchasing_readonly: Ukuthengwa okuphakathi kwabelwa ngaphasi kokuhlelwa kwepahla yesibhedlela.
inv_setup_central_purchasing_hint: I-PR, PO, kanye ne-GRN yepahla ethengiweko sebenzisa isitolo lesi. Isitolo esikhethiweko sitshwaywe njengokuthenga okuphakathi; eyangaphambilini ibuyela emuva ku-Regular.
inv_pr_trace_hint: Lokha umugqa uphelele ku-oda lokuthenga, inani elivulekileko lingu-0 lapha; ithrekhi e-odiweko, eyamukelwe, nesazokwamukelwa esikrinini se-PO ne-GRN.
inv_pr_trace_po_mismatch: Ama-oda wokuthenga akhona we-PR le kodwana irhelo alikwazanga ukulayishwa. Linga ukuvuselela ikhasi.
inv_pr_list_scope_hint: Ibha ephezulu isetha i-inventory yakho / isibawo (kusukela) esitolo. Irhelo litjengisa iimbawo eziphakanyiswe sitolo leso. Khetha zoke iintolo ukubona iimbawo ezivela kizo zoke iintolo ezibawako, nofana usebenzise isihlungi sekholomu yesitolo ukunciphisa ngokusuka esitolo.
inv_stock_list_scope_hint: Isitoko silinganiselwe esitolo esisebha ephezulu. Khetha zoke iintolo ukubona zoke iintolo esibhedlela.
inv_di_list_scope_hint: Irhelo likhawulelwe ema-indents akhutjhwe sitolo ebha ephezulu. Khetha Zoke iintolo ukubona woke ama-indent weminyango.
inv_flow_procurement_chain: Yenza isibawo sokuthenga esitolo esibawako (ibha ephezulu) → ngemva kokuvunywa, yenza i-oda lokuthenga bese uthumela i-GRN esitolo esamukelako → erhelweni le-GRN, sebenzisa i-Transfer ukuthuthela isitoko esamukelweko esitolo esivule isibawo (lokha i-PR ihlotjaniswa ne-PO).
inv_flow_pr_context: Ukusuka esitolo kuvela ebha ephezulu. Khetha ukugcina isicelo lesi.
inv_flow_po_context: Ama-PO wesitolo esikhethiweko (ibha ephezulu) alandela iimbawo zokuthenga ezivunyelweko nofana ukungena ngesandla; Vuma bese uthumela kumthengisi ngaphambi kokwamukelwa kwempahla.
inv_flow_grn_context: Thumela amarisidi esitolo esamukelako (ibha ephezulu). Lokha i-PO nayihlotjaniswa nesibawo, sebenzisa i-Transfer ukuthumela isitoko esitolo esibawako ngemva kokuposa i-GRN.
inv_po_list_select_store_hint: Khetha isitolo ebha ephezulu ukutjheja irhelo leli, nofana usebenzise Woke ama-oda wokuthenga esibhedlela lokha nakunganasitolo esikhethiweko.
inv_page_department_issue_subtitle: Isitolo esiphakathi (ibha ephezulu = Ukusuka esitolo) siphakamisa iindaba ezitolo ezibawako: kungaba yi-indent yomnyango evunyelweko elindele ukuzaliseka, nofana ngesandla ngaphandle kwe-indent.
inv_flow_dept_issue_context: Njengama-oda wokuthenga: sebenzisa okutjha okuvela emnyangweni lokha nakucelwa isitoko esitolo sakho esiphakathi ngokusebenzisa i-indent; sebenzisa iManyuwali lokha nakunganakho ukungena.
inv_inventory_from_store_topbar_hint: Tjhugulula isilawuli esithi "Kusukela esitolo" ebha ephezulu (eduze negatja / isiqhema sabasebenzisi) lokha isigaba se-Inventory sivulekile.
inv_dept_issue_pending_indents_help: Ama-indent la avunyelwe sitolo esibawako begodu alindele bona uvule indaba yomnyango. Khetha isitolo esiphakathi ebha ephezulu.
inv_di_pending_central_fulfill_hint: Yenza umraro womnyango ukusuka ku-Inventory → Umraro womnyango → Omutjha ukusuka emnyango we-indent (isitolo esiphakathi kufanele sifane ne-indent “kuya” esitolo ebha ephezulu).
inv_dept_issue_select_store_hint: Khetha isitolo esiphakathi (esigcwalisako) ebha ephezulu. Irhelo litjengisa imiraro lapho isitolo siyikhipha khona (Kusukela).
inv_page_receipt_from_store_subtitle: Vuma irisidi esitolo sakho esibawako (kusuka ebha). Ama-indent akhutjhweko avela lapha bekube kulapho atholwa khona.
inv_receipt_from_store_select_store_hint: Khetha isitolo sakho esibawako ebha ephezulu ukutlola ama-indents alindele ukwamukelwa esitolo leso.
inv_page_department_consumption_subtitle: Rekhoda ukusetjenziswa esitolo ngokubanjwa kwezinga leqoqo. Thumela ukuze uvunywe; ukuvunywa kokugcina kuposa ukusetjenziswa begodu kwehlisa isitokwe.
inv_dc_list_scope_hint: Irhelo lingalandela isitolo ebha ephezulu nofana litjengise zoke iintolo.
inv_dc_configure_dc_approvers: Hlela abavumi bokusetjenziswa komnyango (imojuli ye-DC) yesitolo lesi ku-Inventory Setup → Ukuhlelwa kokuvuma.
inv_dc_modal_batch_help: Amaqoqo alayishwa ukusuka esitokisini esitolo esikhethiweko sento le.
inv_dc_batch_qty_exceeds_stock: Inani lidlula isitokwe esikhona sebhetjhi eyodwa nofana ngaphezulu.
med_order_save_failed: Bekungakghoni ukulondoloza. Hlola okufakiweko bese uzama godu.
med_order_delete_confirm: Susa umugqa lo? Lokhu angeze kwabuyiselwa emuva.
med_order_batch_pick_help: Faka inani ngesiquntu ngasinye (iyunithi yokuthenga). Amatotali avumelanisa nensimu yobunengi bomugqa.
med_order_inventory_invalid: Hlola inani leenqhema kanye nentengo yokuthengisa.
med_order_int_missing_master: Hlela imvamisa, iyunithi yomthamo, kanye neyunithi yesikhathi ekuhlelweni kwe-oda lemithi, bese uzama godu.
med_order_int_past_start: Ilanga lokuthoma angeze laba ngaphambi kwanamhlanjesi.
med_order_int_save_failed: Ukulondoloza kwehlulekile. Hlola umlayezo weseva bese uzama godu.
med_order_int_update_failed: Ukubuyekezwa kwehlulekile. Hlola umlayezo weseva bese uzama godu.
med_order_int_saved: I-oda lemithi lilondoloziwe. Kwanikelwa inomboro etja yeqoqo.
med_order_int_delete_confirm: Susa isiqhema soke nayo yoke imigqa yaso? Lokhu angeze kwabuyiselwa emuva.
med_order_int_no_batches: Akukho ama-oda wemithi alondoloziweko malungana nokuvakatjha lokhu.
med_order_int_editing: Ukuhlela i-oda elondoloziweko: amatjhuguluko asebenza ekuvuseleleni.
med_order_int_reorder_stagger_aria: Yenza i-oda etja elondoloziweko (iqoqo elitjha) ukusuka emgqeni wokuthoma we-oda. Isikhathi sokuthoma sisemva kwesikhathi sokuphela sakamuva kilokhu kuvakatjha, nofana kusukela nje nangabe lokho bekungaba sesikhathini esidlulileko.
med_order_int_reorder_append_confirm: Londoloza i-oda etja ngenomboro etja yeqoqo, usebenzisa umugqa wokuthoma we-oda? Isikhathi sokuthoma sibekwa ngemva kokuphela komugqa wakho wangaphambilini. Uhlala ohlwini lomlando.
med_order_int_reorder_line_appended: I-oda etja igcinwe ngenomboro etja yeqoqo.
med_order_int_starts_staggered_toast: Isikhathi sokuthoma silandela ukulandelana kwelayini. Umugqa ngamunye uthoma ngemva kwesikhathi esipheleleko somugqa odlulileko. Imvamisa nemithamo ayitjhuguluki.
inv_pr_create_disabled_store_not_requisi: Isitolo lesi angeze senze iimbawo zokuthenga. Vulela ukuthenga okutlhogekako ku-Store Master.
home_inv_dashboard_subtitle: Ukuhlolisisa ububanzi begatja obukhethiweko kubha yokuzulazula.
home_inv_dashboard_stock_alerts_hint: Ukubala kufaka hlangana iintolo ezisemagatjeni owakhethileko kwaphela. Izexwayiso zangaphakathi kwe-app nama-imeyili athunyelwa ngesitolo ngasinye osibhalisele kiso, begodu ngokwehlukana ngesitoko esiphasi vs esiphelelwa sikhathi msinyana (engeza isitolo ngasinye ngaphasi kokuhlelwa kwe-Inventory → Izexwayiso zesitoko).
inv_reports_card_dc_desc: Imigqa yokusetjenziswa ethunyelwe ngenani lokuthengisa le-EMP kanye namanani welayini.
inv_report_date_range_invalid: Ilanga lokuya kufanele libe ngelanga namkha ngemva kwelanga lokusuka.
inv_reorder_level_subtitle: Beka imikhawulo ephasi yesitoko ngesitolo ngasinye nento.
inv_reorder_level_min_qty_conversion_hin: Faka inani eliphasi ngamayunithi wokuthenga; igcinwa njengenani lesitokwe (ukukhipha) ngokusebenzisa ukuguqulwa okukhethiweko.
inv_stock_alert_subtitle: Khetha bona ngisiphi isitolo umuntu ngamunye asitjhejako, kanye namatjhuguluko we-imeyili kanye nefasitela lokuphelelwa sikhathi msinyana.
inv_stock_alert_policy_hint: Amafasitela wokuphelelwa sikhathi kwento ngayinye angasethwa ku-Item Master (kudlulisa okuzenzakalelayo kwesibhedlela ngezansi).
inv_stock_alert_in_app_gap: Isikhathi sokupholisa sesaziso sangaphakathi kuhlelo lokusebenza (imizuzu)
inv_stock_alert_policy_email_channels: Izexwayiso zangaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza zilandela amabhokisi wokuhlola wabamukeli kwaphela. Ukuthola ama-imeyili, vula umhlobo ngamunye wesiyeleliso lapha (obulungiweko), hlela i-SMTP kuseva, begodu uqinisekise bona ilunga ngalinye lokungena nge-Better Auth linekheli le-imeyili.
inv_stock_alert_invalid_days: Amalanga aphelelwa sikhathi kufanele abe hlangana no-1 ukuya ku-365.
inv_stock_alert_invalid_gap: Imizuzu yokupholisa kufanele ibe okungenani yi-1.
inv_stock_alert_recipients_hint: Umugqa ngamunye uyisitolo esisodwa nelungu elilodwa labasebenzi. Iinyeleliso zihlanganisa isitoko sesitolo kwaphela: zifanisa ikholomu yesitolo embikweni wesitoko esiphasi. Sebenzisa amabhokisi wokuhlola athi Isitoko esiphasi / Siphelelwa sikhathi msinyana emgqeni ngamunye; Umthethomgomo godu uneentjhuguluko ze-imeyili ezihlukileko. Abasebenzi ababelwe esibhedlela kwaphela abangafakwa.
inv_stock_alert_recipient_exists: Ilunga labasebenzi sele libhalwe esitolo lesi.
inv_stock_alert_cron_body: Ukuthola izexwayiso ezifike ngesikhathi kanye ne-imeyili, shayela indawo yokugcina le ngesikhathi esibekiweko (isib. qobe ngemva kwemizuzu eli-15). Sebenzisa i-imeyili=1 kwaphela lokha i-SMTP ihlelwe.
inv_stock_alert_cron_secret: Thumela ihloko Igunya: Umthwali <CRON_SECRET> nofana i-x-cron-secret. Setha i-CRON_SECRET endaweni yeseva.
inv_store_markup_percent_invalid: Ukumakwa kwesitolo kufanele kube hlangana kuka-0 no-999.
inv_pricing_template_subtitle: Amafomula weentengo zokuthengisa asetjenziswa godu (i-MSL, amaflegi weendleko). Yabela igatja nemojuli ekuhleleni intengo.
inv_pricing_assignment_subtitle: Khetha ithempulethi eyodwa yefomula ngegatja ngalinye nemojuli yokuthengisa. Ukuthengisa nokusabalalisa ukugeleza kusebenzisa ithempulethi eyabelwe ngesikhathi sokuthengiselana.
inv_pricing_assignment_unassigned_warnin: Ayikho ithempulethi eyabelwe: ukuthengiswa kwale mojuli egatjeni leli kuzokuhluleka bekube kulapho unikele khona.
inv_pricing_assignment_overview_subtitle: Ngiyiphi ithempulethi yefomula esebenza esibhedlela ngasinye, igatja, nemojuli.
inv_pricing_config_subtitle: Yabela ithempulethi yefomula ngegatja nemojuli yokuthengisa (ukuthengisa kwangaphakathi, ukuthengisa kwangaphandle, ukusetjenziswa komnyango).
inv_pricing_config_branch_locked_hint: Ukusebenzisa igatja ukusuka ebha yokuzulazula: {branch}. Khetha "Woke amagatja" ku-nav ukukhetha igatja elihlukileko lapha.
inv_pricing_config_sale_help_manual: Faka intengo yokuthengisa emgqeni ngamunye we-GRN lokha nawuposa.
inv_pricing_config_emp_use_percent_of_sa: Sebenzisa amaphesenti wentengo yokuthengisa (ungazitjheji iindleko ezingezansi)
inv_pricing_config_emp_help_manual: Faka intengo yokuthengisa yabasebenzi emgqeni ngamunye we-GRN lokha nawuposa.
inv_pricing_config_invalid_markup: Ukumaka kufanele kube hlangana kuka-0 no-999.
inv_pricing_config_invalid_emp_percent: Iphesenti labasebenzi kufanele libe phakathi kuka-0 no-999.
inv_pricing_preview_hint: Ibalwe ukusuka kufomula eyabelwe ngesikhathi sokuthengiselana (ingagcinwanga esiqhemeni).
inv_pricing_preview_unavailable: Akukghoni ukubala ukubuka kwangaphambili kwentengo. Hlola isabelo semojuli kanye nesixhumanisi se-GRN seqoqo.
item_master_item_markup_percent_hint: Ngokukhetha. Isetjenziswa esikhaleni se-ITEM lokha nakubalwa intengo yokuthengisa ngesikhathi sokukhipha nofana sokubhadela.
item_master_item_markup_percent_invalid: Ukumakwa kwento kufanele kube hlangana kuka-0 no-999.
inv_store_markup_percent_hint: Ngokukhetha. Isetjenziswa esikhaleni se-STORE lokha nakubalwa intengo yokuthengisa evela esitolo lesi.
item_master_expiry_alert_lead_days_hint: Nokukhethwa. Amalanga ngaphambi kokuphelelwa sikhathi ukufaka ifulegi njengezinto eziphelelwa sikhathi msinyana. Tjhiya kunganalitho ukusebenzisa okuzenzakalelayo kwesibhedlela kusuka ezixwayisweni zesitoko.
item_master_expiry_alert_lead_days_inval: Faka inombolo epheleleko hlangana no-1 no-365, nofana uyitjhiye inganalitho.
mo_clinical_workspace_empty: Azikho iingulani ezivunyelweko ezitholakalako kobana zibonisane.
home_seo_title: Menzies Medora | Ukusebenza kwesibhedlela okuthulileko kwawo woke amathimu wokunakekela
home_seo_description: I-Medora yi-EMR yezibhedlela ezinengi zokutlolisa, ukuvakatjhela, umsebenzi wezokwelapha, ukuhlola izinto, nokuphatha. Ikhonsoli eyodwa ye-Soft Wash yabanikazi, abasebenzi, kanye namaphasi wokunakekela.
home_hero_headline: Yenza amalanga wesibhedlela abe yisikhathi esithulileko, esihlobeneko
home_hero_body: I-Medora: imisebenzi yokutlhogomela iimbhedlela ezinengi ngokutloliswa, ukuvakatjhela, amabhentjhi wokusebenza wezokwelapha, kanye nezinto ezikhona kukhonsoli eyodwa yomqatjhi.
home_how_lead: Ukugeleza okukodwa kokungena nokutlhogonyelwa okubhukiweko. Yakhelwe isikhathi lapho amathimu atjhugulula khona iingulani.
home_how_step1_body: Thatha ubunikazi, ukungezwani komzimba, nomlando kanye. Njalo ukuvakatjha kwamuva kusebenzisa kabutjha itjhadi elifanako.
home_how_step2_body: Yenza ukuvakatjhela i-OP nofana i-IP, faka ama-aphoyintimenti, begodu ugcine ubujamo begatja bucacile ephasini.
home_how_step3_body: Iindaba eziqakathekileko zobuhlengikazi, ukuhlolwa, ama-oda wemithi, kanye namadokhumende aphila ngesikhathi esifanako sokuvakatjha.
home_how_step4_body: Iindaba ze-inventory, ukudluliselwa kwemali yokubhadela, kanye namagadango wokukhipha kuhlala kuhlotjaniswa nerekhodi lokuvakatjha.
home_modules_lead: Amaphakethe wamakhono ahlanganisa amadeski ekufuze ahlale ahambisana: ihhovisi langaphambili, amaphasi wezokwelapha, iintolo, kanye nomlawuli.
home_modules_registration_body: Umphathi wesigulani, ukudalwa kokuvakatjhela, ukubekwa, kanye nokuhlolwa kwamagatja.
home_modules_clinical_body: Amamojula wobuhlengikazi nokubonisana anezinto eziqakathekileko, ukuhlolwa, ama-oda, kanye namanothi we-EMR.
home_modules_inventory_body: Iintolo, amaqoqo, i-PR/PO/GRN, ukusetjenziswa komnyango, kanye nezexwayiso zesitokwe.
home_modules_admin_body: Abasebenzi, amagatja, amaqembu wabasebenzisi, amakhosi, amadokhumende, nokuhlelwa kwesibhedlela.
home_model_heading: I-SaaS eyodwa. Izibhedlela ezinengi. Hlanza iindima.
home_model_lead: I-Medora inezibhedlela ezinengi ngendlela eyakhiwe ngayo. Ipulatifomu yenza isibhedlela. Isibhedlela siphatha ukutlhogomela. Iingulani azisoze zidinge ihhovisi lakho langemuva.
home_model_platform_body: Abaphathi besistimu abanikazi bembewu, iimbhedlela, kanye nama-guardrail woke umqatjhi abelana ngawo.
home_model_hospital_body: Abanikazi nabaphathi bahlela amagatja, iintolo, ukufikelela kwabasebenzi, namakhosi.
home_model_staff_body: Abongikazi, abodorhodera, kanye namathimu wesitolo basebenza ngamamojuli aqaphela indima ephasini.
home_model_patients_body: Amatjhadi, ukuvakatjhela, namadokhumende ahlala esibhedlela; abasebenzi bakhonza ukusuka ekhonsoli.
home_surfaces_nursing_body: Iindaba eziqakathekileko, ukungezwani komzimba, amanothi wobuhlengikazi, nemisebenzi eseceleni kombhede ngaphandle kokutjhiya ukuvakatjhela.
home_surfaces_consult_body: Ukuhlolwa, ama-oda wemithi, kanye namadokhumende wezokwelapha edesikeni likadorhodera.
home_surfaces_inventory_body: Yamukela, khipha, dlulisela, begodu uhlole isitokwe ngokwazi iqoqo nokuphelelwa sikhathi.
home_surfaces_admin_body: Abasebenzi, amagatja, amaqembu wokufinyelela, abaphathi bamadokhumenti, nokuhleleka.
home_integrated_heading: Gcina woke amadeski asemgqeni wesikhathi munye
home_integrated_lead: Ukubekwa, imithi, amadokhumende, nokuthuthwa kwesitokwe kwabelana ngokuvakatjha ukwenzela bona iphasi lihlale liqondile.
home_cta_body: Ngena ngemvumo kukhonsoli ye-Medora, khetha isibhedlela, bese uthoma ngamamojula isiqhema sakho esivele siwasebenzisa.
home_footer_tagline: Imisebenzi yesibhedlela yokutlolisa, ukutlhogonyelwa kwezokwelapha, ukuhlola izinto, nokuphatha.
home_footer_copyright: © {year} Menzies Medora. Isofthiwe yokutlhogomela eyenziwe ngu-Menzies.
home_scene_aria: Umfanekiso we-Soft Wash wesibhedlela eceleni kwemithi egcekeni elithulileko
pricing_seo_title: Intengo ye-Menzies Medora | Ifu kanye ne-On-premise
pricing_seo_description: Intengo ye-EMR yesibhedlela se-Medora: Ifu ukusuka ku-$99/ngenyanga (ukuthoma ukuya eplatifomu). I-on-premise isebenzisa amazinga afanako ngentengo ye-Cloud + $150/mo ukufaka emthangalasiseko wakho. Ukutloliswa, umtholampilo, i-inventory, kanye nokuphatha.
pricing_lead: I-Cloud SaaS nofana i-On-premise emthangalasiseko wakho. Amazinga afanako we-Starter, iBhizinisi, iSikali, kanye nePlatifomu. Yenzelwe iimbhedlela namamojula, ingasi ukutshwenyeka kwemitha yokuvakatjhela ngalinye.
pricing_lead_cloud: I-Cloud iphathwa nge-Soft Wash Medora: i-SaaS yezibhedlela ezinengi, ukubuyekezwa okulawulwako, kanye nesakhiwo esabelwana ngaso kiyo yoke indawo oyisebenzisako.
pricing_lead_onprem: I-on-premise yizigaba ezifanako zomkhiqizo, ezifakwe begodu zihlelwe kumaseva wakho, idathabheyisi, kanye nenethiwekhi. Nguwe umnikazi wesakhiwo. Irhelo lenyanga liyi-Cloud + ${premium} yomthwalo loyo.
pricing_lead_mmk: Ukutjengisa i-MMK ku-1 USD = {rate} MMK ukumadanisa indawo.
pricing_lead_usd: I-USD irhelo leentengo zamathimu wephasi loke.
pricing_plan_starter_tagline_onprem: Isibhedlela sinye se-Soft Wash Medora emthangalasiseko wakho.
pricing_plan_starter_f6: Ukusekelwa nge-imeyili nokubuyekezwa okuragela phambili kwe-Cloud
pricing_plan_starter_f6_onprem: Ukusekelwa nge-imeyili; ukubuyekezwa kwendlela yakho yokukhipha
pricing_plan_business_tagline: Isitaki esizeleko sesibhedlela samathimu wokunakekela akhulako.
pricing_plan_business_tagline_onprem: Isitaki esipheleleko sesibhedlela sifakwe ku-infra yakho.
pricing_plan_business_f2: Amagatja, amaqembu wabasebenzisi, kanye namakhosi wamadokhumenti
pricing_plan_business_f4: I-PR / PO / GRN kanye nezixwayiso zesitoko
pricing_plan_scale_tagline_onprem: Imisebenzi yezibhedlela ezinengi ku-infra yakho ngokuhlanganiswa.
pricing_plan_platform_tagline_onprem: Abasebenzisi abaphethe iimbhedlela ezinengi nge-infra yakho.
pricing_plan_platform_f2: Iinvakatjhi ezinelebula emhlophe kanye neendawo zokuphrinta
pricing_plan_platform_f6: Ukuthunyelwa kwemilayezo yevolumu kanye neenkhetho zokuhlala kwedatha
pricing_plan_platform_f6_onprem: Umlayezo omkhulu nokuhlala okuqinileko kunethiwekhi yakho
pricing_who_lead: Ipulatifomu, isibhedlela, abasebenzi, nezigulani ngamunye uthola umzila ocacileko. Khetha i-Cloud nofana i-On-premise, bese kuba yi-tier efanako ehambelana nokuthi zingaki iimbhedlela namamojula owaphetheko.
pricing_who_platform_body: Abasebenzisi abatjala iimbhedlela ezinengi begodu badinga i-white-label kanye ne-SSO. Khetha Iplatifomu ku-Cloud nofana On-premise.
pricing_who_hospital_body: Abanini nabaphathi bahlela amagatja, iintolo, ukufikelela kwabasebenzi, namakhosi. Ibhizinisi nofana i-Scale ifanelana namaqembu amanengi wamasayithi amanengi.
pricing_who_staff_body: Abongikazi, abodorhodera, kanye namathimu wesitolo ngamamojula aqaphela indima. Imikhawulo yezihlalo ilinganiswa nepulani; iingulani azisoze zibone i-ofisi yangemuva.
pricing_who_patients_body: Amatjhadi, ukuvakatjhela, namadokhumende ahlala esibhedlela. Abasebenzi basebenza ukusuka ekhonsoli ngaphetjheya kokubhalisa ukuya ekuvaleni.
pricing_faq_q1: Ingabe intengo ngokuvakatjha namkha ngesihlalo sabasebenzi?
pricing_faq_a1: Amazinga agadangisiweko ngeqembu ngalinye lesibhedlela elinamakhava wesibhedlela nezihlalo. I-Cloud ne-On-premise yabelana nge-Starter, iBhizinisi, i-Scale, ne-Platform. Irhelo lenyanga elikhona nge-Cloud + $150. Akukho nanye indlela esebenzisa imitha yokuvakatjha ngayinye ekhuphuka ngamalanga aphithizelako.
pricing_faq_a2: Ukukhokhiswa kwaqobe mnyaka kuvala umnyaka oqalekako we-Soft Wash Medora. I-SaaS yesibhedlela yesitayela se-Loomline kanengi yehlisa amapulani weminyaka ngama-15 ukuya ku-20%. I-Medora isebenzisa i-20% ehlwini lenyanga lokha nawubhadela qobe mnyaka, kokubili i-Cloud ne-On-premise (ngemva kwe-+$150 On-premise premium).
pricing_faq_a3: I-Starter ifaka hlangana ukutloliswa okuqakathekileko, ukuvakatjhela, kanye namabhentshi wokusebenza wezokwelapha ane-inventory eyisisekelo. Ibhizinisi nangaphezulu kuvula ukugeleza komsebenzi okuzeleko, ama-oda wemithi ahlotjaniswa nesitoko, kanye nokuhlelwa komlawuli okucebileko. Buza bona utlhoga nini izengezo ezilawulwako.
pricing_faq_a4: Sebenzisa ukutjhugulula imakethe ngaphezulu kwamapulani. Iphasi loke litjengisa i-USD kwaphela. I-Myanmar itjengisa i-MMK ku-1 USD = 5000 MMK (nge-USD njengolayini wesibili). Isikhathi sokubhadela kanye nemodi yesevisi zihlukile emakethe.
pricing_faq_a5: I-Cloud iphathwe nge-Soft Wash Medora: i-SaaS yezibhedlela ezinengi, ukubuyekezwa okulawulwako, nokuthoma okurhabako. I-on-premise isebenzisa amazinga afanako, afakwe emthangalasiseko wakho lokha nawufuna ukulawula nofana indawo yokuhlala. I-Infra ngeyakho; irhelo lenyanga nge-Cloud + $150 yomthwalo loyo.
pricing_trial_lead: Sitjele ngezibhedlela zakho nokuthi utlhoga isikhathi esingangani. Sizokulandela nge-imeyili.
pricing_trial_message_placeholder: Amasayithi, umthwalo ophakemeko, i-Cloud nofana ikhetho le-On-premise...
